title: Meet the Azure cloud
summary: Microsoft Azure offers rented services for computing, storage and networking. A useful design begins with the job, not with the longest list of services.
introduction: Microsoft Azure offers rented services for computing, storage and networking. A useful design begins with the job, not with the longest list of services. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Microsoft Azure offers rented services for computing, storage and networking. A useful design begins with the job, not with the longest list of services.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: No Azure account or payment details are needed to read this course. Examples describe fictional resources. Creating or changing real resources is a separate authorised activity.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Microsoft Azure. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Creating real cloud resources can incur charges; these lessons only describe them.
For more detail later, use this [Microsoft Azure further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/azure-setup-guide/).
